purpose: Part 5/5 of verified exact 50-record item effect batch 029; together these files contain exactly 50 reviewed records from the current 130-record checkpoint.

items/morningstar-of-the-many-611.name: Morningstar of the Many [Relic]
items/morningstar-of-the-many-611.effectSummary: For a chaotic-evil, neutral-evil, or chaotic-neutral wielder, this is a +1 morningstar and overcomes damage reduction as though it had chaotic, evil, good, and lawful descriptors. With the relic connection to Erythnul, five times per day it can mutate for 6 rounds while retaining its +1 enhancement: round 1 vicious morningstar; 2 flaming-burst shortspear; 3 anarchic morningstar ; 4 wounding battleaxe; 5 unholy morningstar ; 6 vorpal longsword, then returns to +1 morningstar. Relic use requires worship of Erythnul and either a sacrificed 5th-level divine slot or True Believer with at least 9 HD.

items/necklace-of-fireballs.name: Necklace of Fireballs
items/necklace-of-fireballs.effectSummary: Only the wearer can detach a sphere and throw it up to 70 feet; on arrival it bursts as a fireball (DC 14), with damage determined by sphere size. If the necklace is worn or carried when its bearer fails a save against magical fire, the necklace also saves at +7; on failure, all remaining spheres detonate simultaneously. Types: I = one 5d6 and two 3d6; II = one 6d6, two 4d6, two 2d6; III = one 7d6, two 5d6, four 3d6; IV = one 8d6, two 6d6, two 4d6, four 2d6; V = one 9d6, two 7d6, two 5d6, two 3d6; VI = one 10d6, two 8d6, two 6d6, four 4d6; VII = one 10d6, two 9d6, two 7d6, two 5d6, two 3d6.

items/necklace-of-natures-teeth.name: Necklace of Nature's Teeth
items/necklace-of-natures-teeth.effectSummary: A druid with wild shape can use the necklace once per day to wild shape into the animal represented by its teeth. Random type by 1d10: 1 black bear, 2 boar, 3 crocodile, 4 leopard, 5 giant lizard, 6 Medium shark, 7 constrictor snake, 8 Medium viper snake, 9 wolf, 10 wolverine.

items/necklace-of-the-wild-beast.name: Necklace of the Wild Beast
items/necklace-of-the-wild-beast.effectSummary: The necklace functions for a wearer capable of casting charm animal and carries one or more special single-use beads; removing a bead destroys its power. Bead of calming casts calm animals; servitude casts dominate animal; fang casts greater magic fang; beckoning casts summon nature's ally IV; great beast casts animal growth; awakening casts awaken. Each bead becomes permanently inert after use.

items/rod-of-reversal-605.name: Rod of Reversal [Relic]
items/rod-of-reversal-605.effectSummary: For a neutral, neutral-good, neutral-evil, chaotic-neutral, or lawful-neutral wielder, commanding the rod makes it reflect the next three spell levels targeting the wielder as a lesser spell turning effect; this works three times per day. With the relic connection to Boccob, each activation instead reflects the next nine spell levels and the rod continuously grants Improved Counterspell. Relic use requires worship of Boccob and either a sacrificed 8th-level divine slot or True Believer with at least 15 HD. Turned spells change the rod's color by school: abjuration blue, conjuration yellow, divination indigo, enchantment green, evocation red, illusion violet, necromancy black, transmutation orange.

items/rod-wonder-525.name: Rod of Wonder
items/rod-wonder-525.effectSummary: Activating the rod is a standard action and produces a random d% effect. Effect table 1: d% | Wondrous Effect; 01-05 | Slow creature pointed at for 10 rounds (Will DC 15 negates).; 06-10 | Faerie fire surrounds the target.; 11-15 | Deludes wielder for 1 round into believing the rod functions as indicated by a second die roll (no save).; 16-20 | Gust of wind, but at windstorm force; see Winds, page 95 (Fortitude DC 14 negates).; 21-25 | Wielder learns target's surface thoughts (as with detect thoughts ) for 1d4 rounds (no save).; 26-30 | Stinking cloud at 30-ft. range (Fortitude DC 15 negates).; 31-33 | Heavy rain falls for 1 round in 60-ft. radius centered on rod wielder.; 34-36 | Summon an animal-a rhino (01-25 on d%), elephant (26-50), or mouse (51-100).; 37-46 | Lightning bolt (70 ft. long, 5 ft. wide), 6d6 damage (Reflex DC 15 half).; 47-49 | Stream of 600 large butterflies pours forth and flutters around for 2 rounds, blinding everyone (including wielder) within 25 ft. (Reflex DC 14 negates).; 50-53 | Enlarge person if within 60 ft. of rod (Fortitude DC 13 negates).; 54-58 | Darkness , 30-ft.-diameter hemisphere, centered 30 ft. away from rod.; 59-62 | Grass grows in 160-sq.-ft. area before the rod, or grass existing there grows to ten times normal size.; 63-65 | Turn ethereal any nonliving object of up to 1,000 lb. mass and up to 30 cu. ft. in size.; 66-69 | Reduce wielder to 1/12 height (no save).; 70-79 | Fireball at target or 100 ft. straight ahead, 6d6 damage (Reflex DC 15 half).; 80-84 | Invisibility covers rod wielder.; 85-87 | Leaves grow from target if within 60 ft. of rod. These last 24 hours.; 88-90 | 10-40 gems, value 1 gp each, shoot forth in a 30-ft.-long stream. Each gem deals 1 point of damage to any creature in its path: Roll 5d4 for the number of hits and divide them among the available targets.; 91-95 | Shimmering colors dance and play over a 40-ft.-by-30-ft. rea in front of rod. Creatures therein are blinded for 1d6 rounds (Fortitude DC 15 negates).; 96-97 | Wielder (50% chance) or target (50% chance) turns permanently blue, green, or purple (no save).; 98-100 | Flesh to stone (or stone to flesh if target is stone already) if target is within 60 ft. (Fortitude DC 18 negates).

items/shortbow-composite-560.name: Shortbow, composite
items/shortbow-composite-560.effectSummary: A composite shortbow requires two hands and can be used while mounted. Each bow has a Strength rating; if the wielder's Strength bonus is below it, attacks take -2. The bow allows adding Strength bonus to damage up to its rating, but never more than the wielder actually has. Each +1 of supported Strength bonus adds 75 gp to cost. For proficiency and feats it counts as a shortbow.

items/strand-of-prayer-beads.name: Strand of Prayer Beads
items/strand-of-prayer-beads.effectSummary: After the owner casts a divine spell, they instantly know the strand's powers and activation. Lesser strand: blessing + healing beads; standard: healing + karma + smiting; greater: healing + karma + summons + wind walking. Each special bead works once per day except summons, which works once total and then becomes nonmagical; removing a bead destroys its power. Blessing, smiting, and wind walking are spell-trigger; karma and summons can be activated by any divine caster. Bead effects: blessing casts bless; healing casts one of cure serious wounds/remove blindness-deafness/remove disease; karma grants +4 caster level for 10 minutes; smiting casts chaos hammer, holy smite, order's wrath, or unholy blight (Will DC 17 partial); summons calls an appropriately aligned powerful Outer Planes creature for one day; wind walking casts wind walk.

items/tailbands-of-impact.name: Tailbands of Impact
items/tailbands-of-impact.effectSummary: These three resizing bands work automatically for any creature with a tail-slap attack; creatures without one gain no benefit. A tail wearing them counts as adamantine and magic for overcoming damage reduction. They increase Strength contribution to tail-slap damage: if normally x1/2, use x1; if normally x1, use x1-1/2; if normally x1-1/2, use x2.

items/word-of-chaoss-power.name: Word of Chaos's Power
items/word-of-chaoss-power.effectSummary: After studying the tablet's runes for at least 1 minute, a creature understands their purpose; after a further hour of study, the runes fade and the creature learns the word as a supernatural ability. Each invocation functions as a rod of wonder and permanently drains 1 Wisdom. At Wisdom 0, the user becomes completely insane and falls into an unending nightmare-filled sleep. Knowledge of the word cannot normally be taught directly; reproducing it requires creating another written copy with the associated gp/XP investment, or comparable magic such as wish to place the knowledge in a willing mind.
